background.description: The page the mark sits on.

surface.description: Cards, tabs and bars a step off the background.

ink.description: The mark's main colour; the SVG draws it with currentColor.

accent.description: The mark's accent; the SVG draws it with var(--accent).

notes.description: Markdown: what this round is, and what to look at.

name.description: The product's name, as a browser tab and the menu bar would show it.

wordmark.description: The name as the lockup sets it; defaults to name. Wrap part of it in [brackets] to set that part in the accent: pin[/]rail.

wordmark_font.description: A CSS font-family for the wordmark. The view cannot load fonts, so name one the viewer has, with fallbacks.

svg.description: A whole <svg> element with a square viewBox. Ink as currentColor, accent as var(--accent); scripts, event handlers and external links are removed.

reasoning.description: Markdown: the idea behind the mark, and what to look for.
